key.name: connection-uri
key.description: The libvirt URI the window lists virtual machines from.

key.name: window-size
key.description: The width and height of the main window when it is not maximized.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized the last time it closed.

key.name: definition-editor-size
key.description: The width and height of the window a machine’s XML definition is edited in.

key.name: show-advanced-settings
key.description: Whether a machine’s details show the settings few machines need: disk and network card models, clock, power actions, pinning, and the scripts run as it starts and stops.
